prompt: This table may hold errors. Two lines are copies of one order line when order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id and line_discount_eur all match, with a missing promo_id matching a missing one; every line beyond the first of such a set is a resent copy. Which query returns the number of resent copies, as n_copies?

options.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_line_id) AS n_copies
FROM order_lines

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_copies
FROM (
  SELECT order_id, product_id
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS copied

WITH line_sets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_copies
FROM line_sets

WITH line_sets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT SUM(n_lines) AS n_copies
FROM line_sets
